Name: froststar11's Hedgehogs for 1.6
Author: silvermoonchan
Description:
With permission from froststar11, I've converted their BFAV Hedgehogs (found  [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6794]here[/url]) to work on SDV 1.6. Credit goes to froststar11 for the original mod.

Hedgehogs live in coops and will produce various colors of quills.

Enjoy!
